turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been feeling fatigued for about six months, along with an unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the same period. I’m still eating well and I don’t smoke or take any medications.
Thank you for that information. Have you experienced any fevers, drenching night sweats, or noticed any new lumps or swollen lymph nodes?
No, I haven’t had any fevers or drenching night sweats, and I haven’t noticed any new lumps or swollen lymph nodes. I also haven’t had any recent infections or bleeding issues.
Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea, constipation, or abdominal pain?
“No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my bowel habits—no diarrhea, constipation, or abdominal pain. Everything’s been pretty normal in that regard.”
Have you noticed any palpitations, heat intolerance, tremors, or increased anxiety?
“No, I haven’t noticed palpitations, heat intolerance, tremors, or unusual anxiety—just the fatigue and the weight loss.”
Have you noticed increased thirst, frequent urination, or waking up at night to pass urine?
“No, I haven’t had increased thirst or frequent urination, and I’m not waking up more at night to pass urine—this has all been pretty steady except for the fatigue and the 5 kg weight loss.”
Could you please share your age and biological sex?
“I’m a 72-year-old male.”
Have you noticed any blood in your urine, or experienced any difficulty starting or maintaining your urine stream?
“No, I haven’t noticed any blood in my urine, and I don’t have any trouble starting or keeping a steady urine stream.”
Have you experienced a persistent cough, shortness of breath, or chest pain?
“No, I haven’t had a persistent cough, shortness of breath, or chest pain.”
Have you experienced any dizziness, lightheadedness, or shortness of breath with minimal physical activity?
“No, I haven’t had dizziness or lightheadedness, and I don’t get short of breath with minimal activity—my main issue is just the ongoing fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss.”
Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing, early satiety (feeling full quickly after starting a meal), or persistent indigestion?

“No, I haven’t had any trouble swallowing, and I don’t feel full quickly after eating. I also haven’t had persistent indigestion—my stomach feels pretty normal apart from the weight loss and fatigue.”
Do you consume alcohol, and if so, how many standard drinks do you typically have per week?
“I drink alcohol socially, but not heavily—about a few standard drinks per week at most.”
Have you noticed any persistent low mood, loss of interest in your usual activities, or significant changes in your sleep quality?

“No, I haven’t felt persistently low in mood, and I’m still interested in my usual activities. My sleep quality hasn’t noticeably changed either—this has mainly been the fatigue and the unintentional weight loss.”
Have you experienced any persistent bone pain, particularly in your back, hips, or ribs?
“No, I haven’t had any persistent bone pain in my back, hips, or ribs—just the fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss.”
